import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

# Scatter plot to visualize price vs megapixels colored by sensor type
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                          style='has_video_4k', palette='Set2', s=100, alpha=0.7)

# Set the title and labels
scatter.set_title('Camera Specifications: Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
scatter.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
scatter.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)

# Adjust legend
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type / 4K Video', fontsize=12, title_fontsize='13', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
